name: Holographic 3D display system based on sensitized photorefractive polymer
aliases: University of Arizona PRP Holographic Video Display
definition: A dynamic holographic display using sensitized photorefractive polymer (PRP) material that blurs the boundary between printed holography and CGH by refreshing images every 2 seconds.
summary: This system uses sensitized photorefractive polymer to store holographic fringes in a bulk volume, enabling high-brightness 3D images visible under ambient light.
